ValidationRule.description: Evidence fields can be set once.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(AND(ISCHANGED(ConfirmedBy__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(ConfirmedBy__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(ConfirmedDate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(ConfirmedDate__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(TargetRecordId__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(TargetRecordId__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(RequiredConfirmation__c), PRIORVALUE(RequiredConfirmation__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(PIIMaskingApplied__c), PRIORVALUE(PIIMaskingApplied__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Provider__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Provider__c))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once a step has recorded who confirmed, which record, which provider or that masking ran, that evidence cannot be changed.
